{{Current events header|2016|10|12}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Iraqi Civil War (2014–present)|Iraqi Civil War]]
**[[Prime Minister of Iraq|Iraqi Prime Minister]] [[Haider al-Abadi]] rejects [[Turkey]]'s claim that their forces must be included in an operation to retake the militant-held city of [[Mosul]]. [http://www.militarytimes.com/articles/iraqi-pm-rejects-turkish-claim-to-take-part-in-mosul-campaign (''Military Times'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2015–present)|War in Afghanistan]], [[Violence against Shia Muslims]]
**A bomb explosion among crowds of [[Shia Islam|Shiite Muslims]] defiantly gathered to mark [[Day of Ashura|Ashura]], one of their holiest commemorations, kills  at least 12 and wounds 28 others. Also, authorities revise  the death toll to 17 from yesterday's attack on a [[Kabul]] Shiite shrine. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/deadly-blast-targets-shiite-worshipers-in-afghanistan-amid-widening-security/2016/10/12/a7b5dda2-907c-11e6-9c52-0b10449e33c4_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Business and economy
*[[John Stumpf]] resigns as CEO and chairman of [[Wells Fargo]] amid a scandal over its sales practices. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-37639648 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] [[Prince Zeid bin Ra'ad|Zeid Ra’ad al-Hussein]] says U.S. presidential nominee [[Donald Trump]], if elected,  would be dangerous from an international point of view because of his comments about deporting [[Illegal immigration|undocumented immigrants]], barring [[Muslim]]s from entering the country, and employing [[torture]] tactics. [http://www.nytimes.com/2016/10/13/world/europe/donald-trump-un-human-rights.html (''The New York Times'')] [http://thehimalayantimes.com/world/trump-as-us-president-pose-global-danger-un-rights-chief/ (Reuters via ''The Himalayan Times'')] [http://www.bbc.com/news/election-us-2016-37628345 (BBC)] 
**Russian UN ambassador [[Vitaly Churkin]] says  Zeid shouldn't criticize heads of state and government. [http://www.dw.com/en/un-rights-chief-trump-would-be-dangerous-if-elected/a-36023164 (''Deutsche Welle'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Burundi]]
**The [[Parliament of Burundi]] votes overwhelmingly to withdraw [[Burundi]] from the [[Netherlands|Dutch]]-based [[International Criminal Court]]. [http://www.reuters.com/article/us-burundi-icc-idUSKCN12C1LH (Reuters)]
